messages:
alice: Quick ask — can someone run a focused microbench + quality sweep comparing int4 / int8 / fp8 for rw-13b (our tuned variant) on seq=512 and seq=1024? Want latency/throughput, memory, and promptset-quality metrics.

alice: TL;DR: need numbers to decide default quant profile for Dedicated; target GPUs: A100-80 and H100-80. If possible, use batch sizes 1,4,8 and our promptset promptset_release_v2.

alice: Example bench command:
```
python perf/bench.py --model rw-13b --precision {int4,int8,fp8} --seq 512 --batch 4 --gpu a100-80 --runs 5 --out /tmp/bench.json
```

ben: I'll pick this up today on A100s. Can you upload the promptset and exact eval script? I have limited H100 time but can run A100 now.

carla: I'll run the quality evals. Use embed-sim and exact-match on the promptset_release_v2; also check hallucination rate on the "fact-check" slice. Thresholds: <=1.5% EM drop vs fp16 is acceptable, hallucination delta <=2%.

ben: ok noted. Where's the canonical eval script? last one I used was evals/llm/quality_v4.py

dave: FYI, if you run int4 we should enable the fallback kernel check flag so we see any solver-triggered fallbacks: set RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 and attach kv-cache logs. Example:
```
export RUNTIME_DEBUG=1
python ... --log-kv
```

eva: For canary gating, product wants latency regressions <10% and tail p95 <20% vs current fp16 baseline. Quality can't drop more than the thresholds Carla mentioned.

infra-bot: job 8792 queued on pool:eng-runtime-a100; ETA ~15m :rocket:

ben: job started. I'll paste results when done. If anyone wants to pair on the profiling flamegraphs ping me.

carla: started quality runs, using promptset_release_v2 slice: fact-check + dialog-short + code-gen-small. Leaving a note to compare BLEU and embed-sim.

alice: thanks. If int4 shows small quality delta but large cost win, we might adopt it for Dedicated with option to pin int8 for customers requesting higher accuracy. Keep notes on rollback plan.

ben: first results (seq512, batch1, A100): int4 throughput 320 tok/s, int8 260 tok/s, fp8 350 tok/s; latency p50: int4 28ms, int8 34ms, fp8 25ms. Memory: int4 24GB, int8 28GB, fp8 26GB. Uploading /tmp/bench_1991234567_a100.json

carla: quality quick diff vs fp16 (approx): int4 EM -0.9%, int8 EM -0.4%, fp8 EM -0.3%; hallucination delta: int4 +1.8%, int8 +0.6%, fp8 +0.5%.

dave: looks like int4 is within acceptance for most slices but watch fact-check slice (int4 up to +3% hallucination). Recommend canary with restricted promptset.

eva: agree. Product ok to proceed with int8 default and a controlled int4 rollout for non-sensitive workloads. Please prepare PR with docs + canary config.

alice: thanks all — assigning follow-ups: @ben upload perf artifacts and generate flamegraphs; @carla write a short eval memo and add fact-check examples; @dave add a runtime flag guard and rollback steps; @eva coordinate canary plan with product. I'll open the PR once we have artifacts.

ben: ack. ETA tonight.

carla: ack, will have memo by EOD.

dave: will open runtime PR tomorrow morning.

infra-bot: job 8792 completed successfully in 18m :white_check_mark:

alice: great job team :tada:
